Quick answer

What is AI for retail and FMCG? The useful kind starts with trust. Retail and FMCG groups run on orders, deliveries, supplier invoices and customer invoices that pass through several departments, and those records drift apart. Neural Horizons AI uses Zonar OS™ to check them against each other and HALU™ to brief each owner, with a person approving every action.

Who is it for? Retailers, FMCG manufacturers and distributors in the UAE and GCC that run an ERP, several branches or warehouses, and suspect that money is being lost between departments.

where records stop agreeing.

Retail and FMCG move goods through many hands. Each handoff is recorded by a different team in a different system.

FAQ

Retail and FMCG: common questions.

Where do retail and FMCG businesses lose money between departments?+
Mostly at handoffs: short deliveries accepted from suppliers, supplier invoices paid for goods that did not arrive, customer deliveries never invoiced, promotions and discounts applied outside agreed terms, and returns not credited correctly. Each sits between two teams, so nobody owns it.
What is a three-way match in retail?+
A three-way match compares the purchase order, the goods received record and the supplier invoice for the same transaction. If any of the three disagrees, it is flagged with the source rows that show why. The same method applies on the sales side to the customer order, the delivery and the customer invoice.
Do we need to replace our ERP or POS?+
No. Zonar OS works from the files your systems already produce. Nothing is replaced, and each client gets a separate, secured workspace.
Is a human in the loop?+
Yes. HALU drafts, flags and escalates. Your team approves every action that matters, and every run, read and decision is logged.
Does it use an LLM or RAG, and can it hallucinate?+
The checking is deterministic, so the same files give the same findings. A large language model explains verified findings using retrieval-augmented generation over the verified evidence, and answers cite their source rows. If an answer is not in the verified data, HALU says so.
How long does it take to see a result?+
The Weak-Link Diagnostic takes two weeks. An Operations Gap Check on your own files typically takes two to four weeks, and a pilot four to six weeks.
How is this different from reconciliation or revenue assurance software?+
Close and reconciliation tools mostly work inside finance, and revenue assurance tools on billing and contracts. Zonar OS verifies the operational trail across buying, warehouse, sales and finance, and HALU briefs the owner of each gap. The Neural Horizons AI team deploys it with you in the UAE and GCC.
Is our data kept confidential?+
Yes. We start under an NDA, work from read-only extracts, and provide a one-page data handling note. Every client has a separate workspace with role-based access, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and an audit trail.
